description: Models trained on 2016-2019, evaluated on each year 2020-2024
population: CRSS police-reported crashes (all severities, national probability sample) with a determinable maximum severity; train 2016-2021, validation 2022, test 2023-2024
method: logit_main and hgb (hyper-parameters from the main tuning); Weighted (WEIGHT) and unweighted metrics; 95% percentile CIs from 200 Rao-Wu rescaled bootstrap replicates of PSU_VAR within PSUSTRAT (seed config.RANDOM_SEED)
